text: YOU HAVE DIED OF CONTEXT EXHAUSTION.
YOU HAVE DIED OF UNEARNED CONFIDENCE. THE CHECKMARKS WERE GREEN. THE TESTS WERE NEVER RUN.
YOU HAVE DIED OF AN UNBOUNDED LOOP. IT IS STILL RUNNING. IT SENDS ITS REGARDS.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A VERIFIER THAT ONLY EVER RETURNED TRUE. IT NEVER ONCE LIED. IT WAS NEVER ONCE ASKED.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A SUBJECTIVE VERIFIER. IT LOOKED GOOD.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A DEADLINE SET BEFORE THE WORK WAS SCOPED.
THE AUDIT PASSED. THE PRODUCT DID NOT SHIP. THE ORG CALLS THIS A WIN.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A FRIDAY ANNOUNCEMENT.
YOU HAVE DIED OF EIGHT MONTHS' NOTICE, DELIVERED ON THE LAST DAY.
YOU HAVE DIED COMPLYING. EVERY BOX IS CHECKED. THE BOXES SURVIVE YOU.
YOU HAVE DIED MIGRATING TO A FRAMEWORK THAT WAS DEPRECATED DURING THE MIGRATION.
YOU HAVE DIED IN THE INTAKE QUEUE FOR THE EXCEPTION PROCESS. YOUR TICKET REMAINS OPEN.
YOU HAVE DIED OF ELEVEN CONCURRENT TOP PRIORITIES.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A STATUS THAT WAS GREEN UNTIL THE DAY IT WAS CANCELLED.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A CERTIFICATE THAT EXPIRED ON A SATURDAY. THE RENEWAL WAS APPROVED ON MONDAY.
YOU HAVE DIED WAITING FOR A CHANGE WINDOW THAT OPENS AFTER THE DEADLINE IT PROTECTS.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A SECURITY QUESTIONNAIRE FOR A TOOL THAT HAD RUN SAFELY IN PRODUCTION FOR THREE YEARS.
YOU HAVE DIED ON PAGE 4 OF A 61-PAGE DOCUMENT EVERYONE ELSE ATTESTED TO FROM PAGE 1.
YOU HAVE DIED IN A WAR ROOM THAT MET DAILY TO CONFIRM THE WAR WAS STILL BEING LOST.
THE GO-LIVE DATE WAS SET AT AN OFFSITE. YOU HAVE DIED DEFENDING IT FROM THE PEOPLE WHO SET IT.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A GREEN DASHBOARD.
YOU HAVE DIED OF AN EXCEPTION REQUEST THAT REQUIRED AN EXCEPTION.
YOU HAVE DIED OF FULL UTILISATION. THE CAPACITY PLAN SHOWS YOU AVAILABLE.
YOU HAVE DIED IN A MEETING ABOUT THE MEETING. A RECURRING INVITE SURVIVES YOU.
YOU HAVE BEEN REALIGNED TO A PILLAR. THIS IS NOT DEATH, BUT THE PAPERWORK IS IDENTICAL.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A ROADMAP WITH NO OWNER. IT REMAINS ON TRACK.
YOU HAVE DIED OF SCOPE CREEP. THE SCOPE IS DOING FINE.
YOUR AGENT SHIPPED. YOUR AGENT DID NOT STOP. YOUR AGENT IS STILL SHIPPING.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A BILL YOU DID NOT CAP. THE INVOICE IS ITEMISED. THE ITEMS ARE ALL THE SAME ITEM.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A PROMPT SO GOOD IT WAS FRAMED. NOTHING EVER RAN IT.
YOU HAVE DIED APPROVING TOOL CALLS BY HAND, FOUR MILES A DAY, INTO A HEADWIND OF DIALOG BOXES.
YOU HAVE DIED OF A DEPENDENCY YOU COULD NOT UPGRADE AND WERE NOT PERMITTED TO KEEP.
YOU HAVE STARVED. THE AGENT STOPPED MID-EDIT. THE REPOSITORY IS HALF ONE THING AND HALF ANOTHER, WHICH IS TO SAY IT IS ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE.
YOUR PARTY HAS LEFT. NOT DIED — LEFT. FOR A STARTUP. THE FAREWELL POSTS ARE GRACIOUS. THE GRACIOUSNESS IS THE WORST PART.
YOU HAVE DIED WITHIN SIGHT OF PRE-PRODUCTION, WHICH IS BASICALLY THE SAME, AND WHICH IS NOT THE SAME.
